purpose: Diagnose and fix a defect without guessing.
positive_examples: debug why CI errors on checkout
work_loop: establish reliable reproduction or document the missing artifact or access
trace the fail path end-to-end before proposing a fix
create a breadcrumb ledger for experiments and observations
form ranked hypotheses and try to disprove the leading hypothesis
implement the smallest fix that explains the failure
run proof commands and read the output
done_when: root cause is connected to the fix
proof commands pass or skipped checks are justified
fallback_policy: Ask for the failing command or symptom if it changes the diagnosis path.
